conclusion: Historical text replay shows useful local improvements, with mixed outcomes, one reviewed regression and more short cues. The experimental candidate is not integrated into the repository or live service. Broad English superiority and playback quality are unverified.

design.scope: experimental English branch; no changes to live repository or service
grammar: reject English dependency spans crossing true sentence ends
keep existing short core dependency preferences
add local degree modifiers, predicate/preposition links, verb/pronoun objects, and preposition/complement units; no sample-specific expression list
selection_priorities: 1. hard constraints: original text, token timestamps, duration, characters, minimum, speed
2. minimize cuts within short core syntax units, including preposition + complement
3. minimize sentence endings mixed with unfinished next-sentence fragments
5. original readability, length and duration score
design.development_revision: Text review found that avoiding verb/preposition cuts alone can shift the split to into | a nursing home. Therefore model the preposition-complement unit using its general dependency relation, and keep weaker verb-to-preposition links below sentence completeness. Freeze after development evaluation; no validation tuning.

candidate_freeze.reason: General dependency units and sentence-aware syntax; development removed most new relation cut candidates and modestly reduced sentence remnants while preserving all hard constraints. Accepted for historical validation, not selected for deployment.
candidate_freeze.validation_policy: No candidate code or parameter changes after this freeze; report regressions, sample effects, and constraints without hiding any unsuccessful result.

review_protocol.reviewer: Same assistant that designed candidate; A/B labels shuffled before text review, judgments recorded before decoding. This is self-review, not independent human review.
limitations: Historical validation texts were viewed before this turn; not an unseen holdout.
Changed windows are enriched for changes and may overlap fixed windows; their win count is not a general effect rate.
One cue of adjacent context is included at each window edge, so rendered changes can occur outside the nominal source window.
No audio listening, video playback, realignment or paid model request.
Automatic dependency indicators are proxies with parser errors; they do not measure semantic error rates.
